Product Overview:
Designed for summer activities such as beach outings, surfing, and hot spring visits, these men's casual board shorts feature a loose, straight-leg cut made from breathable polyester fabric for maximum comfort.

Specifications:
Material: 100% Polyester
Style: Casual
Craft: Woven
Elasticity: Non-elastic
Thickness: Regular
Leg Style: Straight leg
Season: Summer
Occasion: Beach, swimming, hot springs, daily casual wear
Color Options: B2022-1 Dark Blue Vertical Stripes, Dark Blue and Red Stripes, Light Blue Flamingo, White and Blue Vertical Stripes
Size Range: S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL, 4XL, 5XL, 6XL
Measurement Tolerance: 1 cm

Note: 1. Asian sizes are 1 to 2 sizes smaller than European and American people. Choose the larger size if your size between two sizes. Please allow 2-3cm differences due to manual measurement. 2.
